 The Maharashtra State Board of Secondary and Higher Secondary Education (MSBSHSE) is expected to release the Maharashtra Board SSC and HSC Time Table 2027 soon. Students appearing for the Maharashtra Class 10 and Class 12 board examinations in 2027 are eagerly waiting for the detailed subject-wise date sheet to plan their final examination preparation.
 The Maharashtra Board has already announced the tentative examination schedule for the February-March 2027 session. According to the announced schedule, Maharashtra HSC Class 12 written examinations will begin on February 8, 2027, while SSC Class 10 written examinations are scheduled to commence on February 15, 2027.
 However, the detailed Maharashtra SSC Time Table 2027 and Maharashtra HSC Time Table 2027, containing individual subject examination dates and paper timings, have not yet been released. Students will be able to check the official timetable PDF through the board's website, mahahsscboard.in, once published.
 Candidates should regularly check the official website for the latest announcement and avoid relying on unofficial timetable PDFs circulating on social media.
 Maharashtra Board Time Table 2027: Latest Updates
 The Maharashtra Board has announced the tentative examination dates for SSC and HSC students appearing in the 2027 board examinations. The detailed subject-wise timetable is awaited.
 Here are the important updates students should know:
 Board: Maharashtra State Board of Secondary and Higher Secondary Education (MSBSHSE)
 Examinations: SSC Class 10 and HSC Class 12
 Academic Session: 2026-27
 HSC Theory Exam Start Date: February 8, 2027
 HSC Theory Exam End Date: March 16, 2027
 SSC Theory Exam Start Date: February 15, 2027
 SSC Theory Exam End Date: March 11, 2027
 HSC Practical and Internal Assessment: January 20 to February 6, 2027
 SSC Practical and Internal Assessment: January 28 to February 13, 2027
 Detailed Subject-Wise Timetable: Awaited
 Official Website: mahahsscboard.in
 The examination schedule applies to students under the Maharashtra Board's nine divisional boards. The detailed timetable will provide subject-wise dates and examination sessions.
 Maharashtra SSC, HSC Exam Dates 2027
 The Maharashtra Board has announced the tentative examination window for Class 10 and Class 12 students. Students can use these dates to organise their revision schedules while waiting for the detailed date sheet.
 Maharashtra HSC Time Table 2027: Class 12 Exam Dates
 The Maharashtra HSC examinations 2027 will commence on February 8 and continue until March 16, 2027. Students from the Science, Commerce and Arts streams should check the detailed subject-wise timetable after its official release.
 The practical, oral, graded and internal assessment examinations for HSC students are scheduled from January 20 to February 6, 2027.
 Maharashtra SSC Time Table 2027: Class 10 Exam Dates
 The Maharashtra SSC Class 10 written examinations are scheduled to begin on February 15 and conclude on March 11, 2027.
 Students should use the available preparation time to complete their syllabus, practise previous years' question papers and revise important chapters.
 The practical, oral, graded and internal assessment examinations for SSC students are scheduled from January 28 to February 13, 2027.
 Important: These are the announced tentative examination dates. Students must refer to the final official timetable and subsequent board notifications for the subject-wise schedule and any changes.
 How to Download Maharashtra Board SSC, HSC Time Table 2027 PDF?
 Once the Maharashtra Board releases the detailed Class 10 and Class 12 timetable, students will be able to download the date sheet from the official MSBSHSE website.
 Follow these steps to access the Maharashtra Board Time Table 2027 PDF:
 Visit the official website, mahahsscboard.in . 
 Open the latest notifications or examination section on the homepage.
 Look for the Maharashtra SSC Time Table 2027 or Maharashtra HSC Time Table 2027 notification.
 Select the relevant Class 10 or Class 12 timetable link.
 The subject-wise date sheet PDF will appear on the screen.
 Check the examination dates, subject names and paper timings carefully.
 Download the PDF and save it for future reference.
 Students should keep a copy of the official timetable and verify their examination schedule with their respective schools or junior colleges.
 Maharashtra Board Time Table 2027: How Students Should Use the Date Sheet
 The release of the Maharashtra SSC and HSC timetable is an important step in the board examination preparation process. A date sheet does more than inform students about their examination dates. It helps them identify the time available between consecutive papers and prepare a structured revision strategy.
 Here are some practical ways students can use the Maharashtra Board 10th and 12th timetable effectively.
 1. Identify the Gap Between Two Examinations
 After downloading the timetable, check the number of days available between consecutive examinations. Subjects with shorter gaps may require additional preparation before the examination period begins.
 Students should avoid depending entirely on the gap between two papers for completing the syllabus.
 2. Prepare a Subject-Wise Revision Plan
 Divide the remaining preparation period according to the examination schedule. Give priority to subjects that have more chapters to revise or require additional numerical and written practice.
 For Class 10 students, a balanced approach towards languages, Mathematics, Science and Social Science can help improve overall preparation.
 Class 12 students should organise their revision according to their respective Science, Commerce or Arts subjects.
 3. Practise Previous Years' Question Papers
 Solving previous years' Maharashtra Board question papers can help students understand the examination pattern, question formats and commonly tested concepts.
 Students should attempt papers within the prescribed examination duration to improve time management and identify topics that require more practice.
 4. Focus on Difficult Chapters First
 Students should identify chapters and concepts that they find difficult before preparing their final revision timetable. Completing these topics earlier can reduce last-minute examination pressure.
 5. Keep Practical and Theory Examinations Separate
 Students appearing for the SSC and HSC examinations should also account for practical, oral, graded and internal assessments while preparing their study schedules.
 Since these assessments are scheduled before the written examinations, students should coordinate with their schools and junior colleges to avoid missing any assessment-related instructions.
 6. Verify Paper Timings and Subject Codes
 After downloading the official PDF, carefully check the subject names, examination dates, paper timings and subject codes. Students should not depend on screenshots or forwarded timetable images without verifying them against the board's official announcement.

 Previous years' timetable release dates provide some context, although they do not guarantee the release date for the current academic session.

 Maharashtra Board SSC, HSC Time Table 2027: Important Instructions for Students
 Before beginning their final examination preparation, students should keep the following points in mind:
 Download the timetable only from the official Maharashtra Board website.
 Check whether the PDF is meant for SSC Class 10 or HSC Class 12.
 Verify the subject-wise examination dates and paper timings.
 Note the dates for practical, oral and internal assessments separately.
 Maintain a subject-wise revision schedule based on the examination dates.
 Follow school and junior college instructions regarding examination arrangements.
 Check official notifications regularly for timetable revisions or additional instructions.
 Students should also remember that the detailed subject-wise date sheet is different from the tentative examination schedule. The final examination timetable should be treated as the primary reference for individual paper dates.
 Maharashtra Board SSC, HSC Time Table 2027: Official Website
 Students can visit the Maharashtra State Board's official website to check the latest updates regarding the SSC and HSC examinations.
 Official website: https://mahahsscboard.in/ 
 The board is expected to publish the detailed Maharashtra SSC and HSC Time Table 2027 PDF through its official platform. Candidates should regularly check the notifications section for the latest updates.
 As of November 2, 2026, the detailed subject-wise timetable has not been officially released. Students are advised to continue their preparation according to the announced tentative examination dates and wait for the final date sheet.
